metadata.title: Tesla Faces Another U.S. Safety Recall

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Tesla Inc. (TSLA, Financials) is recalling 20,349 vehicles in the U.S. after regulators found certain low-beam headlights can be too bright, the electric vehicle company said.The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said the recall involves some Model 3 and Model Y automobiles.Regulators warned the lamps could impair visibility for oncoming cars and increase the chances of crashes. There is no word yet on any final remedy.For a corporation the scale of Tesla, on its own, the recall is rather tiny. The larger problem is that it comes as the automaker is already facing greater scrutiny over vehicle safety.NHTSA started a preliminary probe in July into over 1.2 million Tesla vehicles after receiving allegations of suspension issues that could lead to loss of steering control.Tesla shares were slightly changed in premarket trade. The new recall alone is unlikely to have a substantial financial impact on investors. The bigger concern is whether repeated safety inquiries begin to yield bigger repair costs or regulatory pressure.
